item.title: Strangers helped a college student get to his friend in the hospital
item.description: While Jake Berry was in college, he learned one of his oldest friends was in the hospital more than an hour away. Berry didn't have a car, but two strangers gave him a ride.

item.title: 'Shrinking' star Jason Segel isn't afraid to share the 'dirty underneath'

item.title: Portland soap box derby race features a parade of creative gravity-powered cars
item.description: At Portland's annual soapbox derby, motorless cars race downhill pulled by nothing more than gravity. It's part race, part parade, with cars built to look like sharks, guitars and slices of cake.
